title: Abbest Cave - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Abbest Cave in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A short cave off Spring Meadows named for the Abbest that nestle inside it. It is the first place the game asks you to fight a caster-type Nevron that resists Physical damage.

sections.title: How to Reach Abbest Cave
sections.content: Entered from Spring Meadows. The route is signposted but the cave is optional.
